debug.description: Point <service>'s consumer at a local debug session. Original files are never modified.

restore.description: Undo `debug`: delete the generated files and start both services from the originals.

isolate.description: Start the stack from a copy of the compose file with <service> commented out.

suppress.description: Take <service> out of the stack so it can run in a local debug session: comment it out of a COPY of the compose file, relax every depends_on that points at it, point its consumer at the debug host and port, and start the rest. Undo with `unsuppress`.

unsuppress.description: Undo `suppress`: delete the generated compose and env copies and start the whole stack from the originals.

versions.description: The version each service's image carries, and the version the stack is on. Set the variable VERSION to pin the version that builds and checkouts use; without it they use the detected one.

checkout-version.description: Put the source repo <repo> on the commit that matches the version (VERSION, else the detected one): the first existing ref of VERSION_GIT_REFS. Refuses if the tree has uncommitted changes.

debug-image-plan.description: Show what `debug-image` would do for the Dockerfile (or project folder) <source>: which service, which unhardened base image, which tag. Writes nothing. Optional variables: service, baseImage.

debug-image.description: Run a service on a debuggable image instead of its hardened one: write Dockerfile.debug (unhardened base, root, ps, vsdbg), build and tag it, point the service at it through a compose override file, and recreate that one service. The stack keeps running until the build has succeeded. Undo with `restore-image`.

restore-image.description: Undo `debug-image`: take <service> out of the compose override file and recreate it from its original (hardened) image.

digest.description: Condensed logs of <service>: repeated lines collapsed into patterns with counts, errors first.
